entities.summary: Theodore Ushev (b. 1968-02-04, Kyustendil) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kyustendil and Bulgaria. Known in the fields of bulgaria, painters & sculptors, europe.
